requirement: Runtime telemetry schema and manifest files are present and linked to existing run/HIL templates.
boundary: File presence does not prove telemetry was collected.

requirement: Telemetry schema covers timestamps, message latency, frame drops, TF/leader/command age, watchdog, safety state, CPU/GPU load, and rosbag linkage.
boundary: A schema does not create measured timing data.

requirement: Real-robot metric schema contains runtime summary fields needed before embedded-feasibility or timing claims.
boundary: Metric-schema readiness does not prove runtime latency or load.

requirement: Real-robot results template includes every runtime telemetry summary field.
boundary: The example template row is not physical trial evidence.

requirement: Telemetry manifest specifies collection commands, runtime summary, timing thresholds, frame-drop gate, and CPU/GPU thresholds.
boundary: Template thresholds remain TBD until the robot computer is selected.

requirement: Telemetry manifest records target selection, POP/NIS, MPC, safe-command, and safety-state topics.
boundary: Topic coverage must still be verified from rosbag metadata.

requirement: HIL replay manifest links timing evidence to the runtime telemetry schema and summary fields.
boundary: A linked manifest still requires executed bag replay and telemetry extraction.

requirement: Run manifest includes runtime telemetry CSV and manifest paths alongside the metric summary path.
boundary: Path placeholders must be filled during actual trials.

requirement: Real-robot summarizer aggregates latency, frame-drop, clock-drift, command-age, and CPU/GPU telemetry fields.
boundary: Aggregation support does not imply completed robot trials.

requirement: Runtime telemetry dry-run produces a schema-compatible trace, summary checks, and a non-claim report.
boundary: Synthetic dry-run outputs validate the parser path only; they are not rosbag or robot data.

requirement: Runtime telemetry dry-run summary exercises latency, frame-drop, watchdog, clock-drift, command-age, and CPU/GPU summary checks.
boundary: Passing dry-run checks do not prove live ROS2 timing, HIL timing, or embedded feasibility.

requirement: Runtime telemetry dry-run script supports both synthetic trace generation and CSV summary validation against schema fields.
boundary: Parser support is not a substitute for actual rosbag extraction or robot-computer monitoring.

requirement: Manuscript frames runtime telemetry as future validation rather than completed deployment evidence.
boundary: Narrative alignment is not runtime evidence.

requirement: Telemetry manifest states the archive bundle required before timing or embedded-feasibility claims.
boundary: Archive requirements are not collected telemetry.

requirement: Existing pre-real reports retain build, launch, and physical-trial non-claim boundaries.
evidence: boundary terms checked in pre-real reports
boundary: Boundary text prevents overclaiming but cannot replace runtime measurements.
